about: Clarity's `contains` outside a query (text contains part): whether a text holds a part, case ignored for every letter by its simple lower-case form, the same whatever the person's language (no culture: a Turkish person's I is still i), on every stack. An empty part is in every text. Greek final sigma and the Turkish dotted capital I are left out: their lower-case forms differ by language. Each case gives `text`, `part` and whether the text `contains` it.
